meta_description: The Nigeria Immigration Service passport portal needs a 600 × 800 px photo under 2 MB on a white background, ears visible. Crop and download a compliant JPG free.
subtitle: Download a 600 × 800 px JPG on white for the NIS online passport application, or print a sheet for other forms.

rows.label: Accessories
rows.value: No headphones, masks or similar items

rows.label: Lighting
rows.value: Even: neither too dark nor too bright

rows.label: Children
rows.value: ICAO rules are relaxed for children under 5, but they must look toward the camera with the face centred

notes: The NIS portal has a "Test Photo Upload" checker. Run the JPG from this page through it before starting your application.
The NIS photo page only specifies the digital upload. The print sheet here uses 35 × 45 mm; check your form if it asks for a different printed size.
Uploading an ICAO-compliant photo is one of the online application steps, after verifying your NIN and choosing a processing centre.

how_to.title: How to make a Nigerian passport photo
how_to.step1_text: Have someone else take it (no selfies) against a plain light background, following the Nigerian rules below.
how_to.step2_text: Choose the photo. It is processed in your browser and never uploaded to a server.
how_to.step3_text: Centre your face, leave space above and around your head, and zoom so your head is the right size.
how_to.step4_text: Use "Download digital photo (JPG)". It is sized to the official upload spec shown on this page.

items.q: What photo size does the Nigerian passport portal accept?
items.a: 600 × 800 pixels, under 2 MB, on a white background. The digital download on this page produces exactly that.

items.q: Can my hair cover my ears in a Nigerian passport photo?
items.a: No. Hair must not cover your face or ears.

items.q: Do I still need to go to the immigration office?
items.a: Yes. Applicants attend their chosen office for photo and biometric capture.

items.q: How can I check my photo before applying?
items.a: Use the NIS image-compliance "Test Photo Upload" page, which checks a photo against the portal rules.
